notes.title: June 30 update - keyboard mapping fixes
notes.notes:
Changes
[list]
[*] Fix issue where actions could not be mapped to space or alt in keyboard settings
[*] Fix issue where "Restore defaults" and "Unmap all" options wouldn't work in keyboard settings
[/list]

notes.title: June 19 update: 12 new Mayhem mode modifiers and 5 new music tracks!
notes.notes:
Changes:
[list]
[*] Added 12 new modifiers to Mayhem mode, increasing the total number from 8 to 20. The new modifiers include [i]quad shot[/i] (shoot in every direction at once) and [i]slow shield [/i] (the shield travels slowly enough for players to set up advanced reflect combos using multiple shields).
[*] Added "modifier combos" which may trigger later on in Mayhem mode matches. These activate two modifiers at once, creating even more chaotic fun.
[*] Added 5 new music tracks! A million thanks to vrklgn for the musical contributions. There might also be another track hidden somewhere...
[*] The win screen now shows each player's total number of wins for the current session (the session is reset when exiting to the main menu).
[/list]
